question: What is placed in that seat?
premises: In that seat, formerly embodied, with half-syllable, two.
Place as pervader-ness, thus said in Siddha Yogīśvarī Mata.
inference: In that seat one places the two embodied half-syllable forms as pervader-ness.
plain_english: In that seat, formerly embodied, with half-syllable, two; place as pervader-ness, thus said in Siddha Yogīśvarī Mata.
